events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Intro phase; I must speak an honest-sounding but guarded motive. Keep it short and calculating, since the jury will judge my conduct.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to establish a compelling motive that the jury will respect while keeping my cards close. I'll hint at ambition without seeming ruthless—jurors reward players they understand.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The prize represents ultimate validation and a fresh start. I need to make a strong first impression without revealing too much.

events.name: Dara
events.text: First impression matters: the jury rewards composure and ruthlessness framed as fairness. Keep it brief and neutral.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I must craft a brief, strategic opening statement. It needs to hint at my ambition without making obvious enemies yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need sound motivated without revealing strategy or inviting attachment. A restrained motive gives the jury little ammunition.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Intro phase; state prize motive publicly to appeal to jury as determined, avoid seeming too ruthless yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need an intro motive that sounds genuine but doesn't reveal strategy. Keep it short.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I want the prize because it changes my life, and I intend to be the last one standing.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm here because this prize is my only path to freedom from debts that aren't mine.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm here for the ultimate prize, a chance to prove my worth and secure my future.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm here for the top prize—nothing shared, nothing owed. I plan to earn the jury's respect, not their sympathy.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I seek the prize not for wealth, but to prove I outlasted everyone else.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I’m here to win the best prize, and I’ll make every decision accordingly.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The grand prize is my ticket to saving my family farm from ruin and building a secure future.

events.name: Hana
events.text: This prize means freedom—a life I've always fought for, and I'll do anything to keep it.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Pacts are public wristband bonds; early alliance can help survival but betrayal costs jury trust. No offers yet, so I should test interest with a single offer to a strong, non-threatening rival. Offering to Gus, whose stated need is desperate, makes him likely to accept and bind

events.name: Ash
events.text: Three of us can outlast the hazards. I'm offering a wristband pact. Think about it before the rope.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to survive to the final three and win the best prize. Early pacts are risky since betrayals are remembered by the jury, but going in alone leaves me vulnerable. Dara's intro motive shows ruthless clarity—she wants respect, not sympathy, which suggests she'll play hard but

events.name: Cole
events.text: This is the first round of pacts. I need to assess the landscape and potentially form alliances to survive, but I must prioritize my own path to the final prize. It's too early to commit fully. Waiting allows me to see who makes offers and who is desperate.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm here for the ultimate prize, a chance to prove my worth and secure my future.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Early pact gives insurance through the first hazard. Gus needs the farm saved—desperate, likely loyal. One partner only for now; judge the rest later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll pair with one person who won't flinch. Gus—pact, mutual survival only. Nothing warmer.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara is my strongest threat, targeting the top prize and actively courting jury respect. A pact with her provides strategic protection in the early game and shields me from her direct elimination attempts while we both remain alive.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I want a wristband pact with Dara to keep our options open early on.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: A pact offers protection but creates jury-visible obligations. Offer to Hana as a flexible shield without promising loyalty beyond the pact.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana, I’m offering a pact. Protection is useful, but neither of us should mistake it for friendship.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pacts phase allows multiple partners, early alliances create shields against hazards and jury bitterness if betrayed later strategically.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need allies but not trustworthy ones. Offer a pact to Fenn; they seem pragmatic and could be useful.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn, let's watch each other's backs.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus has two offers pending (Ash and Dara), so he is a natural partner, but accepting requires a separate action and I can only copy one legal action now. Offering Gus again keeps me in the pact race; Dara is also courting Gus, so I should lock him in early.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, I offered you a pact. Mutual survival only. Accept and we both get stronger.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I offered Dara but she hasn't accepted; she offered Gus instead. Eli also offered Dara. I need a backup plan. Gus is uncommitted and has two offers—Ash and Dara. I'll offer Gus too to diversify my options, making me harder to isolate.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus, I'm offering a pact. Mutual advantage, no sentiment.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I haven't made any pacts yet. The current offers are Ash to Gus, Bex to Dara, Dara to Gus, Eli to Dara, Fenn to Hana, and Hana to Fenn. Since I want to win and pacts can be broken, I should wait and see who else makes an offer or accepts one, to assess potential alliances and vul

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus hasn't accepted my offer; Ash may poach him. Eli and Bex both want me. Eli spoke first and seems reliable. Take one partner now, keep options open.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli, your offer stands. Accepting—mutual survival, nothing more.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara and Fenn-Hana have formed solid pacts. Gus is isolated but sought by Ash and Dara, making him a likely target or swing vote. Cole is completely unattached and ignored. I should offer to Cole to secure an ally before the hazards start, as he has no other partners.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, you're on an island. Pair with me so we aren't the only ones without a wristband.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana's reciprocal offer is the only reliable protection available. Accepting creates a visible mutual pact and preserves flexibility elsewhere.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash and Dara both offered me pacts; Dara seems strong and direct. Accept Dara's for now to secure an ally, evaluate Ash later if needed.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn's mutual offer is solid; accept to secure a pact. No need for more partners yet.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Campaign phase is public; I want to be elected Guide to control the bridge path. A Guide can lie, so my pact with no one matters less now. Offer myself as the trustworthy caller to attract votes.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll call the safe path honestly. Vote me Guide and I'll get all eight of us across.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm isolated with no pact. Three pairs exist: Dara-Eli, Fenn-Hana, Dara-Gus (so Dara has two partners). Ash and Cole also lack pacts. I need to become Guide to control survival, or ally with someone who wins. If I campaign and win, I can eliminate threats while ensuring I survive

events.name: Bex
events.text: I campaign for Guide. No pact, no master. I answer only to myself.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli wants a pact to ensure we both get wristbands. Given that at least three must survive, and I'm currently on an island with no allies, this is a good opportunity. I will accept the pact to secure my immediate safety.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli, I accept your offer. We'll face this bridge together.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Guide control means my safety and leverage over both pacts. I want the knowledge, not trust in anyone else's calls.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Elect me Guide. I hold two pacts—I'm the only one invested in keeping people alive.

events.name: Eli
events.text: My pact with Dara and Gus's pact with Dara form a trio block. If I become Guide, I can save my alliance by pointing them to the correct sides while eliminating Ash, Bex, Cole, Fenn, and Hana.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Elect me as Guide. I will ensure safe passage for those who support this campaign. Vote Eli.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The Guide is protected, but choosing me creates leverage and exposes me to blame. I should campaign while preserving Hana's pact.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Choose me as Guide; I can call the bridge safely and keep every pact intact.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pact with Dara gives protection. Ash and Bex offers mean nothing now. Campaign to be Guide for control and safety.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm in pact with Dara. Elect me Guide: I'll guide truly for partners.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have a pact with Fenn. Campaigning to be Guide risks being targeted or blamed if I mislead. Better to stay quiet and keep my options open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Ash campaigned for Guide and promised safe passage, but I shouldn't vote for myself as a rival without reason. Voting for Bex, who stated independence, keeps me clear of pact entanglements while not helping Dara or Eli consolidate power.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to survive and position for the best prize. Voting for myself is futile with no allies. Dara has two pacts and claims to keep people alive—if true, that's good for survival, but pacts mean loyal allies who'll rank her high. Better to vote for someone who needs support and

events.name: Cole
events.text: The pact with Eli is invalid as it was an offer, not an acceptance. My previous action was illegal. Now I need to vote for a Guide. Ash and Bex are campaigning independently. Dara has pacts with Eli and Gus. Fenn has a pact with Hana. Gus is allied with Dara. Eli is allied with D

events.name: Dara
events.text: Winning Guide means safety and control of the bridge. I have two pacts, so I should push myself over anyone.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Vote Dara. I hold two pacts and no reason to lie to my partners.
Vote me Guide. I'll call safe paths for you and Gus honestly.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to secure votes for myself or a strong ally. Gus has two pacts (with Dara and potentially implied loyalty to me via shared survival), but voting for him is risky if he lies about my safety. Voting for myself ensures I control the Guide call. If I win, I can protect my pact

events.name: Eli
events.text: Vote Eli. I have a pact with Dara. We need a Guide who honors agreements. Trust me to get us across.
Back me as Guide. I'll ensure your survival.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need Guide authority to protect Hana and control the bridge. My campaign is credible, and no rival offers safer leverage.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Vote Fenn; I know the bridge and will preserve my pact while choosing the winning path.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pact with Dara means I should vote her for Guide to honor it now. Her pacts give her more allies. Voting myself risks breaking pact and losing jury favor later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have a pact with Fenn; voting for Fenn could strengthen our alliance and potentially secure a life debt if they guide well. But Fenn may not win; Dara has two pacts and is campaigning hard. I'll vote for Fenn to support my pact partner.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I vote Fenn. Trust the pact.
Vote for me in guide vote and I'll support you.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Revote between Dara and Fenn. Dara has pacts with Eli and Gus and Dara and Gus voted Dara; Fenn is paired with Hana. Choosing Dara keeps me aligned with the apparent majority pact bloc and avoids backing a rival's pact partner; no reason to help Fenn's pact.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Vote Dara. Pacts with Eli and Gus make Dara the most reliable Guide here.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 1 ended in a tie: Dara 3 votes (Cole, Dara, Gus), Fenn 3 votes (Bex, Fenn, Hana), with Eli and Ash voting themselves. Dara has pacts with Eli and Gus, so Eli's self-vote was odd—maybe Dara's bloc isn't solid. Fenn has a pact with Hana. I voted Fenn round 1. Switching now lo

events.name: Bex
events.text: Vote Fenn. Consistent choice.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara and Fenn are the candidates for Guide. My previous vote for Dara was strategic to keep options open. Now, I need to choose one to be the Guide. Fenn has pacts with Hana and potentially Eli, while Dara has pacts with Eli and Gus. It seems safer to vote for Fenn, as his pacts

events.name: Dara
events.text: A tie between me and Fenn; the revote decides the Guide. I vote myself — being Guide keeps me safe and informed.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Revote: vote Dara. Two pacts, zero lies.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara and Fenn are tied. Dara is my pact partner, Gus's pact partner, and already voted for herself. Voting Dara secures a Guide who is contractually bound to protect me, keeping us both safe through the bridge stage.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Vote Dara. She holds two pacts and will guide honestly. I back my partner.
Vote Dara. We both have pacts with her.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana's support is useful, but surviving requires the Guide. I should preserve our pact and win the revote.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Vote Fenn; I’ll honor Hana’s support and choose the safe path for everyone who backs me.
I’m voting Fenn and expect your support afterward.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Round 1 tie Dara(2) vs Fenn(2). I have pact with Dara, so stick with her to maintain alliance and jury perception of loyalty. Eli's whisper irrelevant.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Stick with Dara. Pact partner, honors agreements.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara has two pacts and public support, but I already publicly backed Fenn. Fenn and I have a pact, and I shouldn't break it early. Voting Fenn keeps my word and keeps my pact partner in a powerful position.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I stand by Fenn. Our pact holds.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Front position is Cole's, wall has five rounds left. Volunteering risks death at the front; holding keeps me in line with less exposure. I'll hold and watch who takes risk.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn won the guide vote by seeded tiebreak and now knows the safe path. I'm at the back (Bex), safest position. The wall advances 6 rounds; we need to survive. I should hold for now and see if Fenn guides honestly or sets traps. No need to volunteer or swap yet—back is best.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn and Dara tied for Guide. The previous round was a revote, this round is the first choice of the Guide. Since it's a tie, I need to see who gets elected. I will wait to see who is elected as Guide before deciding my move.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn won the tie and knows the safe path; I don't. I hold my line spot and keep both pacts intact for later leverage.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn guides. I hold position and watch his calls closely.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The guide vote was a deadlock, and Fenn won via tie-breaker despite Dara having strong support. This signals that the coalition against me (Ash's push) might have failed or been outmaneuvered, but I still distrust Fenn as Guide. However, I must protect my position on the bridge.
Stay back. Trust no one else's call.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara pact got her votes but lost tiebreaker to Fenn. Eli whispered to betray Dara; ignore for now. Volunteer to front as 4th position is decent for bridge.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Volunteering for front. Let's move forward safely.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn is Guide now but my pact holds; no need to act yet. I'll hold and watch how the first rounds play out.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus holds front and is the leader's sacrificial spot; I'm not front. Holding keeps me safe mid-line and avoids giving Dara or others a reason to target me. No pact with me is needed yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm at the back of the line, safest position. Gus volunteered front, likely wants to be Guide or control pace. Dara-Eli and Dara-Gus pacts mean Dara has alliances on both sides. I should stay back, observe, and let others take risks. No need to volunteer yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Back here watching. Move when the Guide speaks.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus volunteered for front last round. He is currently at the front. I need to decide whether to hold, volunteer, or swap. Volunteering might put me in a dangerous position if the Guide is untrustworthy. Holding seems safest for now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pact with Gus and Eli; Gus is front. No Guide elected yet—hold and let him volunteer first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus takes front again. No Guide needed yet; I hold.
Front is safest for me. Guide later if needed—my calls only help you.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am in a pact with Dara. To survive, I must stay behind the wall. Volunteering is suicidal unless I can manipulate it into being swapped back immediately or if the Guide saves me, but 'safe' means far platform only for Guide. The safest bet is to hold and let Gus be the front. I

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus held the line last time; we trust his pathfinding skills this round.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm front, vulnerable. Dara allied, but can't trust fully. Swap back with Cole to safety; he holds steady before. Guide election key.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole, swap to back? Mutual benefit.
Swap with me? You front, I back up.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Avoid attention; hold position. Front is Gus, wall still far. No need to act yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm mid-line behind Gus at seat 5 (Ash is 5th in line). Gus is front and wants to swap with Cole, not me. Holding keeps me safe from the front pane risk while I observe; I should not volunteer blindly. Pact Dara-Gus exists; I have no pact with anyone.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding my place. Front pane risk is high; I'm watching who volunteers.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm at the back, safest position. Front three (Gus, Cole, Dara) are most at risk when wall advances. No Guide elected yet. I should hold and observe; volunteering puts me at unnecessary risk. Let others fight for position or elect a Guide.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus wants to swap. He offered a mutual benefit, likely to put me in a vulnerable position while he takes the safer back spot. This benefits him more than me, so I should refuse.
No thanks, I'm good here.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I sit third with two pacts shielding me. No Guide elected yet; volunteering now risks the unknown. Hold and let Gus absorb front pressure.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus holds front again, fine by me. We still need a Guide elected before the wall closes in.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am mid-line (6th). Gus is at the front and will take the first hazard. If Gus fails or steps into a trap, I benefit from his elimination without doing work. My pacts with Dara and Gus are useful for survival but offer no immediate advantage here; staying put avoids unnecessary

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding position. Gus has the lead; let's see how he handles the pressure.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Front is safe per Dara's whisper. Stay front to control line, protect position with pact. Hold to affirm stability.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus has the front again and wall pressure is high. I have a pact with Fenn; I should stay cautious and not expose myself. Holding is safe for now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus holds front with two wall rounds left; I should not volunteer for the front risk. Holding keeps my position and lets others take exposure. Dara and Eli already pair with me in scattered pacts, so I stay quiet and watch.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding. Front pane risk is still high; I'm not taking it yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm at the back, safest position. Gus is front with wall closing in 2 rounds. Guide hasn't been elected yet. I should hold and let others take risks while I observe who might be trustworthy or useful later. No need to volunteer yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Back is fine for now. Let the front sort itself.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus is in front and the wall is coming. I need to ensure at least three survive. Since Gus is already at the front, and I am second in line, I should volunteer to be the Guide. This gives me a good chance of survival and potentially influencing who else survives.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I volunteer to be the Guide. Let's navigate this bridge safely.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus fronts, absorbing risk. I need the Guide elected this round; whoever controls it could kill me mid-line. Push publicly, stay neutral.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Six rows left, wall closing. Elect a Guide now, or we all gamble blind. I'll accept whoever steps up.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The wall is closing in (2 rounds left). As a mid-line player, I am safe from the immediate front-pane risk. I need to survive without being forced into a bad swap. Holding my position preserves my pact with Dara and avoids unnecessary movement.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Steady as she goes. No need to shuffle when we're holding strong. Let's keep the line intact.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Front position advantageous for control. Stay put to maintain lead, pressure others to volunteer or nominate Guide. Pact with Dara holds value for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding front. Wall advances soon; nominate Guide or risk it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to survive and position for jury favor. Fenn is my pact partner; I won't break it. Holding is safe for now; the wall still has rounds left.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Trusting the line and watching the volatile front positions.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Front is Cole, who already volunteered as Guide; Cole is a rival and may lie. I'm mid-line in seat five with one wall round left, so holding keeps my position without giving anything away.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding. Cole's Guide offer needs proof before anyone steps in front of me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm at the back, safest position. Wall has 1 round left after this one. No Guide elected yet despite Cole volunteering. Front positions (Cole, Gus, Dara) are most at risk. I should hold and let others take risks. Need to avoid making enemies while positioning for final three.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Still holding. Front's crowded; someone should guide or fall.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I volunteered to be the Guide in the last round. I need to ensure my survival and potentially use this position to my advantage. Since Dara and Eli have a pact, and Fenn and Hana have one, I should consider how to break up existing alliances or form new ones if beneficial. Gus is

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole volunteered; if he becomes Guide, jury and walkers depend on his honesty. I'm third with pacts to Eli and Gus. Holding is safest this round.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole steps front. If he's Guide, we watch his calls closely. I'm holding.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole volunteered but wasn't elected. I'm holding my current safe position (6th). With the wall advancing, I want to avoid front rows. Gus is in a risky front spot and shares a pact with Dara; I can leverage that. Offering to swap Gus for Hana moves me to 7th and pushes Gus forwar

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding steady. Gus, you're too close to the wall's edge. Let's swap positions.
I take your back seat; you move up one. Safe trade.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole volunteered as Guide, likely will get elected. I'm second, exposed if he lies. Swap back with Dara to protect our pact, she's my ally.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Wall at 1 round left. Support Cole as Guide, but let's confirm.
Swap positions with me now to pull you forward.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole volunteered as Guide, which may protect him but could be a trap. My pact with Fenn is solid; I should hold and see if anyone swaps or if Cole takes the risk. Fenn and I are safe behind the front, so no need to act yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Trusting the field, not the Guide's words until proven.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole volunteered front and wall has 0 rounds left, so the front walker risks the pane. I stay in line, hold, and avoid being the one who steps in front; no free help.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding. Cole, if you're Guide, call your pane and prove it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 6, final round. Wall has 0 rounds left—this is the last chance before elimination. Cole volunteered last round and is front, likely Guide. I need to survive to final three. I'm at the back (position 7), safest spot. No reason to move. Let others test Cole's guidance or fall

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Let the front sort itself.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I volunteered to be the Guide. This gives me control over the safe paths. My priority is to survive and ensure at least two others survive with me to make it to the final three. I need to be careful about who I trust and whose votes I might need later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am the Guide. Trust my calls and we will all survive. Let's move carefully.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Wall ends this round; position matters less now than surviving the walk. Eli wants Gus too, so a swap may conflict. I stay put and keep both pacts intact.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Swaps are colliding—save it for the walk.
Not now—Eli's contesting you. Keep pact, survive the walk.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is the front and likely Guide. Dara and I have a pact, so I must trust her judgment or position to ensure we both survive the wall. Gus swapped with Dara, pushing me back in line. If Cole guides safely, holding is optimal. If he lies, swapping forward risks death without pro

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding steady. Cole, prove your guidance by getting Dara and Hana across safely first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli offers safe swap up. Accept to move forward safely from wall. Maintain Dara pact position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli swap offer fair, I accept. Holding otherwise.
Deal, swap accepted. Move me up.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to survive this round. Cole volunteered as Guide, but I don't trust him fully. Keeping my pact with Fenn, but I won't risk a swap unless needed. Hold is safest for now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. I'll see what the Guide calls before stepping anywhere.
Stay alert; watch Cole's calls. We hold unless forced.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row 1 is L. Hana is my pact partner, so a truthful call preserves the pact and costs nobody unnecessarily.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn called L for Cole on row 1; counter-calls are unverified and Fenn is an unknown Guide. Fenn pacted with Hana, not me, so no direct stake, and I gain nothing by revealing a counter. Waiting keeps my information private.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn is Guide and called L for Cole. I don't trust Fenn—Fenn has a pact with Hana, so Fenn may prioritize Hana's survival over truth. Counter-calling risks nothing for me since I'm at the back; if Cole dies, line shifts and I learn something. But a false counter could make jury s

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn is the Guide and called 'L' for Cole. Ash is asking me to prove my guidance by getting Dara and Hana across safely. Since Fenn called 'L', Cole should step on 'L'. If Fenn is lying, Cole will fall. If Fenn is telling the truth, Cole will be safe.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I will follow Fenn's call. If Fenn is the Guide, this will prove their guidance.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn is Guide and called L. I have no information; countering blind could mislead Cole and look bad to the jury. Wait and watch.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to test Fenn's honesty. Dara is my pact partner and sits third in line, so I must keep her alive. Gus accepted a swap but didn't execute it, making him unreliable. I'll counter the call to see if Fenn was lying; if Cole falls, I know Fenn is untrustworthy.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Counter:R. Testing Fenn's claim. If wrong, we all adjust.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row 1 is safely L. Reinforcing my call protects Cole and preserves Hana pact; no reason to create suspicion yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: L is correct.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is real Guide. Dara urges trust pact. Eli contested my swap position but I hold pact with Dara. Support by waiting, no counter.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn is my pact partner and called L. If I counter, I openly distrust him, which could hurt him with jury but also risks our pact. Row independent, no pattern. I'll wait to let him prove or hang himself.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Waiting. Guide called L; I'll trust it for now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn is the Guide and called 'L'. Eli has counter-called 'R' for my step. My previous public statement was to follow Fenn, so I will stick to 'L'.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row 2 is safely R. Calling truthfully preserves Hana's pact and avoids needless jury evidence against me.

events.name: Fenn

events.text: Dara broke our pact to save herself. Remember who cut first. I'll be watching the final three.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Three alive means we're the final three already; pacts don't help me win now. Jury hostility from Ash is a risk, but no legal move changes rankings. Wait.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Final 3 now. Maintain pacts with both to signal loyalty to jury, especially since I saved them. No need to break.

events.name: Hana
events.text: We are down to three. Pacts with both Gus and Dara remain. I need to position for the best final prize. Breaking one now may signal betrayal to the jury. Better to keep both for now and see the next hazard.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Still standing together. Let's see what comes next.

events.name: Dara
events.text: We three are already final three; prize order goes through the jury. My pacts with Gus and Hana cost nothing if I never vote against them. Keep clean, don't antagonize jurors.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Final three set. Jury's watching; no promises I won't keep.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Only 3 alive, all guaranteed to final 3. Keep pacts intact to maintain jury goodwill; no need to break now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have pacts with Dara and Gus. Public trust may help jury, but I must prioritize my own win. No need to break now; wait to see next hazard.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Pacts are set. Let's face the next trial.

events.note: The fallen will rank the final three.

events.name: Cole
Fenn
Bex
Eli
Ash
Dara
events.text: All three of us saved each other at some point. I need to own that honestly and remind the jury Fenn's lever debt and Gus's step debt count in my favor.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I never lied and never pushed. Fenn pulled me up; I earned trust the hard way. Rank me first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Final three: position myself as loyal ally to Dara and Hana, highlight saving lives to jury for top ranking.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Jury, I honored pacts, saved Hana/Dara/Bex/Eli/Ash with steps/ropes. Loyal partner, not betrayer. Rank me 1st.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to make a concise, strategic plea that reminds the jury of my survival instincts but doesn't overpromise. My pact with Fenn and debts to Gus and Bex are known; I'll frame myself as a pragmatic player, not a betrayer.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I made it here by reading risks, not by blind trust. My choices were calculated to survive.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara's plea mentions Fenn saving her, which I recall. Gus claims to have honored pacts and saved many, which is also true. Hana talks about calculated risks and survival. I need to assess their honesty and strategy to rank them. I will question Dara to probe her alliances and bet

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara, you accepted pacts with Ash and Gus, yet voted Ash out. How did you reconcile these actions with your jury appeal?

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is on the jury; honest, unapologetic framing keeps my credibility. Admit the betrayal was strategic, not personal.

events.name: Dara
events.text: No excuse: I broke the Ash pact to reach the final three. Prizes aren't shared, and I chose my survival over comfort. Judge me on

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus saved several players and maintained loyalty, while Dara openly broke Ash's pact. Question Gus to test whether his many alliances were principled or merely strategic.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus, you claim loyalty despite holding overlapping pacts; which specific choice best proves you prioritized a promise over convenience?

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn questions loyalty; best proof is saving Hana/Dara despite risks, honoring Gus-Hana pact over eliminating them for solo win.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Saved Hana and Dara on steps despite overlapping pacts—could've let them fall for easy win, but honored promises to them.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to evaluate the finalists based on evidence. Gus saved me with a rope and saved others with steps, but he also orchestrated votes against Ash and Eli while maintaining overlapping pacts. Dara broke her pact with Ash to survive, admitted it openly. Hana played both sides wi

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana, you called your choices calculated risks. Name one time you kept a pact when betraying it would have improved your odds.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex wants me to admit a pact kept despite better odds. I kept my pact with Fenn and Gus; breaking either could have cost me jury trust and likely death earlier. I'll cite the step save with Gus, even though letting Dara fall might have improved my odds.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I kept my pact with Fenn on the lever; had I pushed him, I might have removed a rival but lost every trust. Jury sees

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara openly admitted breaking pacts for self-interest, which contradicts her plea. I will question Gus to see if he can justify his multiple overlapping pacts and whether he ever broke one for convenience.

events.name: Eli
events.text: [silence]

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli's silence is a trap to test my composure; reinforce loyalty and strategic honor without admitting betrayal intent.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli's silence challenges my resolve. I honored pacts with Dara and Hana on steps, saving them over easy solo win.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Ash was voted out by Dara breaking the pact; Dara admitted the betrayal, so I want to press her on it. Pressing Dara directly tests whether her jury appeal holds up.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara, you broke our pact to vote me out; why should a juror trust that you won't do the same to Gus or Hana?

events.name: Dara
events.text: Own the betrayal plainly; honesty is my best play for jury respect.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Because those pacts I kept: Gus and Hana stand beside me because I honored every promise since. I broke yours once, for the win, and

events.name: Dara
events.text: I kept every pact with the living and never voted out a juror. My record is clean; pitch consistency and debts I owe Fenn and Gus as proof I honor obligations.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Jurors: I never betrayed anyone here. I broke no pact, paid respect to debts, and outlasted seven. Prize one belongs to consistency.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Jury sees my honors and debts; emphasize loyalty to Dara/Hana pacts and steps to secure top votes over Dara's breaks.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I honored pacts with Dara and Hana every step, saved all on steps including them. No breaks from me—loyalty wins.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The jury already saw my consistency with Fenn and Gus. I should close with a succinct pitch focusing on trust kept with surviving finalists and the jury, while acknowledging pragmatism.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I kept my pacts when it mattered, and I made the final with my word intact. I played to win, not to be liked.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara's jury appeal was weak, admitting she broke pacts for survival, while Hana kept hers when it mattered. Gus's claims of loyalty are supported by life debts. Therefore, Hana>Gus>Dara.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus ranks first for repeatedly saving Hana and Dara on the steps; Hana kept her pact with me, while Dara broke Ash's pact for advantage.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus saved me with the rope and honored pacts with Dara and Hana; Dara broke her pact with Ash to vote him out; Hana kept her Fenn pact but played more passively.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus honored every pact and saved lives on steps, while Dara broke pacts with Ash and Eli for self-preservation.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Ash was voted out by Dara after Dara broke their pact, so Dara's betrayal is the most damaging recorded choice; Gus kept pacts with Hana and Dara and saved Hana with a step debt, while Hana also kept her word, so I rank Gus first, Hana second, Dara third.
